task: ship a package by buying postage online (USPS Click-N-Ship, FedEx, UPS, PirateShip): enter sender and recipient addresses, package size and weight, choose a service and speed, pay, and get the label printed or a QR drop-off code; complete when the purchased label or drop-off QR code is on screen. Surface pinned: a carrier or postage website/app — not a post-office counter vlog. Variants: tracking a package after it ships, freight or international customs paperwork beyond the standard form, and returns-label flows inside a retailer do not belong.
